topic: Reviewing aggregation script and data metrics
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging an aggregation script used for calculating various digital out-of-home metrics. Initially, [p1] reported that the data quality declined after a recent script update, suggesting reverting to an older version of the script due to discrepancies in 'reach' and 'unique cluster' calculations.

[me] provided guidance on investigating the root cause before rolling back the script. Later, detailed SQL queries were shared for review and testing. The second query was presented as a more expanded test case, incorporating metrics like `session_screens`, `devices_campaign_screens_raw`, and cluster-related calculations.

[p1] confirmed that preliminary checks of the latest scripts appeared satisfactory, with further detailed review scheduled for the next day.
decisions: The initial script version was questioned due to data degradation in reach/unique cluster metrics.
A new, more complex SQL query was shared and tested for expanded metric calculation.
action_items: [p1] will perform a final comparison of the aggregation results and provide feedback.
[p1] will conduct a detailed review of the scripts on the following day.
